set.name: Upload Image
set.description: Picks an image through the WordPress media modal (wp.media). Empty shows a dashed thumbnail and “Select image”; Filled shows the chosen image with Replace and Remove. Both open the same modal. Per-locale text props; buttons are exposed instances.
